dogecoin.text: on this exact day 15 years ago, internet legend kabosu the shiba inu made her first appearance. her side-eye spawned the doge meme, inspired dogecoin, and changed internet culture forever.

sending thoughts to the memorial for julia at eth denver. she was a pioneer in dogecoin and web3, known for her dedication to decentralization and open-source. her spirit lives on through @dogeclaren and the community she built.
